review_method: Source-order full read of all 1200 candidate IDs. The fixed English patch was used as the correction baseline and rationale for localization choices; Japanese was consulted only where needed to resolve semantic ambiguity or an apparent fixed-English-reference defect. Korean was judged for accuracy, naturalness, register, terminology, referent/subject/direction handling, and obvious text breakage. Final result: 31 EDIT and 1169 KEEP, no exclusions and no propagation. All 31 proposed before-values were verified against current Korean, and semantic commit a65a5df89879c189d52b26c93017f5e3e61fae4b passed the existing Korean gates plus the English-consumer storage/effective-layout contract before review-basis registration. No out-of-scope historical cleanup was performed.
